name: Push-Up
description: Beginner strength exercise focusing on chest,triceps.
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders
Lower your chest while maintaining a straight body line
Press away from the floor to return to start
tips: Brace your trunk; keep elbows about 30–45° from your sides

name: Warrior III
description: Balance on one leg while extending the other leg and torso into a long line.
instructions: Begin standing tall.
Hinge forward and extend one leg behind you.
Maintain a long spine, and return with control.
tips: Keep hips level; use a wall for support if needed.

name: Wall Sit
description: Beginner strength exercise focusing on quadriceps,glutes.
instructions: Lean back against a wall
Slide into a comfortable partial squat
Hold with steady breathing

name: Pilates Hundred
description: Pilates core exercise using controlled arm pulses and breathing.
instructions: Lie on your back and lift your head comfortably.
Extend arms by your sides and pulse them with control.
Maintain trunk control while breathing smoothly.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed; modify the leg position as needed.

name: Sun Salutation Flow
description: A connected movement flow linking standing, folding, and floor-based postures.
instructions: Begin standing upright.
Move through a comfortable standing fold and extension.
Transition between floor and standing positions with control.
tips: Move within a comfortable range and coordinate with natural breathing.

name: Box Breathing
description: A structured breathing practice with evenly spaced breath phases.
instructions: Sit or stand in a comfortable position.
Follow the inhale, pause, exhale, and pause prompts specified by the routine.
Return to normal breathing if uncomfortable.
tips: Avoid straining or forcing breath holds.

name: Mindful Breath Awareness
description: A guided attention practice focused on observing the breath.
instructions: Sit in a comfortable position.
Notice natural breathing without trying to change it.
Gently bring attention back when distracted.
tips: Allow attention to return without judgment.

name: Body Scan Meditation
description: A mindfulness practice that guides attention through regions of the body.
instructions: Find a comfortable seated or lying position.
Bring attention through body regions in sequence.
Notice sensations without needing to change them.
tips: A neutral, comfortable posture is sufficient.

name: Tai Chi Weight Shift
description: Slow controlled lateral weight shifting with relaxed posture.
instructions: Stand with feet comfortably apart.
Move weight gradually onto one leg.
Return through center and shift to the other leg.
tips: Keep knees soft and motions unhurried.

name: Lateral Bounds
description: Explosive side-to-side jumping with controlled landings.
instructions: Stand ready with knees soft.
Jump laterally onto the opposite foot.
Land softly and stabilize before repeating.
tips: Begin with small distances and prioritize controlled landings.
